entities.name: TB window prophylaxis <5
observations: CDC-style contact management: in an asymptomatic child younger than 5 years with active TB excluded by evaluation and a negative initial TST, begin window preventive therapy and repeat testing 8–10 weeks after last exposure; a negative initial test does not justify observation alone.
